notes: v1.17 (internal build 37) - everything from the web edition, same-to-same: the update gate's reachability probe now asks the GitHub API (api.github.com) for the release and requires the update file to be listed there at its exact published size (the old github.com download-URL HEAD check always failed CORS, so the gate never engaged); Committees is now its own tab in the Credit Book bottom navigation (Credit Book, then Committees) instead of a button below the cards; the full committee system - per-member mobile numbers, turn number + turn month on every member row, payment entry with amount + date, the turns overview (total turns, turns given, turns remaining, next turn, given list with payout dates) and the member-side giving card. Old committees load unchanged with identical totals. Your records are never touched by updates: the book format only grows, merges instead of replacing, and records you delete never come back.
